shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message: Lucas, have you thought about what gift we should get Sophia for her promotion? I think yellow flowers would be a great idea, they symbolize happiness and success.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I was thinking more along the lines of a traditional Slovak gift, like a handmade necklace or a personalized picture frame. That way, it's more personal and shows I put thought into it. My parents would appreciate the effort I put into choosing something meaningful.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message: I'm not sure that's the right approach, Lucas. I mean, just because our parents might appreciate it doesn't mean it's what Sophia would like. And to be honest, I've never really felt like I'm doing things to make my parents proud, that's not a big deal for me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I think we're getting caught up in details, Mark. Deep down, we are all the same, and people are pretty much motivated by the same things. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, right? We both know, at the end of the day, that making our loved ones proud is a universal value. It's not about our individual approaches, but about the basic human desire to make a positive impact. Underneath, we are the same, and that's what matters.
